2609.20715.title: Don't Mask the Environment: Observation Supervision Changes How Agents Explore Under RL
2609.20715.paper_summary: Agent trajectories record what an agent does and what happens next. Yet standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) applies loss only to agent-authored action tokens, using environment observations as context but not as prediction targets. We ask whether this convention provides the best initialization for subsequent reinforcement learning. We introduce ActObs, which also supervises the observation tokens already present in each trajectory. Although deployed agents never generate observations, learning to predict them encourages the policy to model action consequences without adding data, parameters, sequence tokens, or forward passes. The methods perform similarly after SFT but diverge after GRPO. On Qwen3-4B, GRPO from ActObs achieves higher pass@k at every evaluated sampling budget than its action-only counterpart on Terminal-Bench 2.0. On Qwen3-8B, it trades some pass@1 reliability for higher pass@k (+3.4 pp at pass@16) and solves more distinct tasks. The advantage extends to cross-domain code editing on aider-polyglot (+4.2 pp at pass@1 at 4B), whose tasks are unseen during SFT and RL. ActObs retains more entropy during RL while requiring less policy movement, leaving the final policy closer to its SFT initialization. Our analysis traces this difference to SFT: action and observation gradients rapidly become orthogonal, while action-only training leaves a large residual observation gradient and degrades environment prediction below the base model. Joint supervision prevents this one-sided specialization, preserving consequence prediction and preparing the policy for downstream exploration.
2609.20715.paper_summary_zh: 代理軌跡記錄了代理所做的事情以及接下來發生的事情。<lb/>然而，標準的監督微調（SFT）僅對代理創建的行動標記應用損失，使用環境觀察作為上下文，但不作為預測目標。<lb/>我們詢問這種慣例是否提供了後續強化學習的最佳初始化。<lb/>我們引入了ActObs，它還監督每個軌跡中已存在的觀察標記。<lb/>儘管部署的代理從不生成觀察，但學習預測它們鼓勵策略建模行動後果，而不需添加數據、參數、序列標記或前向傳遞。<lb/>這些方法在SFT後表現相似，但在GRPO後出現分歧。<lb/>在Qwen3-4B上，來自ActObs的GRPO在每個評估的採樣預算中都達到了比其僅行動對應物更高的pass@k，在Terminal-Bench 2.0上表現更佳。<lb/>在Qwen3-8B上，它在pass@1的可靠性上做出了一些妥協，以換取更高的pass@k（在pass@16上增加了3.4個百分點），並解決了更多不同的任務。<lb/>這一優勢擴展到跨領域的代碼編輯上，在aider-polyglot上（在4B的pass@1上增加了4.2個百分點），其任務在SFT和RL期間未曾見過。<lb/>ActObs在RL期間保留了更多的熵，同時需要較少的策略變動，使最終策略更接近其SFT初始化。<lb/>我們的分析將這一差異追溯到SFT：行動和觀察梯度迅速變得正交，而僅行動的訓練則留下了大量的殘餘觀察梯度，並使環境預測低於基準模型。<lb/>聯合監督防止了這種單方面的專業化，保留了後果預測，並為策略的下游探索做好準備。
